exposure: Bovine amniotic fluid combined with bovine xenograft
cohort: The study participants were twenty female Sprague-Dawley rats with experimentally induced peri-implant bone defects in their right tibia bones.
finding: Combining bovine amniotic fluid with bone transplant significantly increased newly regenerated bone formation (41.4% vs 37.4%) and decreased fibrosis formation (33.2% vs 38.6%) in the defect area compared to bone transplant alone.
